defs.def: one of the four long thin parts that stick out from the hand (or five, if the thumb is included) 手指

ex.s: As I read, he reaches out and pokes（戳）the page with his finger.
ex.t: 当我读书时，他伸出手用手指戳（戳）页面。

ex.s: Somehow, I forced my finger to press the button.
ex.t: 不知怎么地，我强迫自己的手指按下了按钮。

ex.s: Franklin then touched the key with his finger and got an electric shock.
ex.t: 然后富兰克林用手指碰了一下钥匙，感受到了电击。

ex.s: The most popular cricket snacks are finger foods like biscuits and cucumber sandwiches.
ex.t: 最受欢迎的板球小吃是手指食物，比如饼干和黄瓜三明治。

ex.s: Fingers crossed that there will be good weather!
ex.t: 祈祷好运，希望天气会好！

defs.def: having the type of fingers mentioned; having or using the number of fingers mentioned 构成形容词
the part of a glove that covers the finger （手套的）指部
a long narrow piece of bread, cake, land, etc. 狭长物（如面包、糕饼、土地等）
to touch or feel sth with your fingers 用手指触摸

ex.s: I don't trust my laptop's spellchecker. ____37____ Of course, these days there are plenty of online dictionaries and thesauruses, but I'm old-fashioned enough to prefer a hard cover and pages I can leaf through with my fingers.
ex.t: 我不相信我笔记本电脑的拼写检查。____ 当然，如今有很多在线词典和同义词典，但我老派得还是更喜欢精装封面和可以用手指翻阅的书页。

ex.s: Awake from a short sleep in her chair, my grandmother ran her fingers through her wavy white hair, looked out her window at the blue sky, and asked me what I would wish for if I had just one wish.
ex.t: 祖母在椅子上小睡醒来，用手指捋了捋花白的卷发，望着窗外的蓝天，问我如果只有一个愿望，我会许什么愿。

ex.s: In Chile, you may never touch any food with your fingers.
ex.t: 在智利，你绝不能用手指接触任何食物。

ex.s: But his smile faded as he rubbed his beard with bony fingers, in thought.
ex.t: 但他一边沉思，一边用瘦骨嶙峋的手指捋着胡须，笑容渐渐消失了。

ex.s: Then she returned silently to her seat, after giving him the key, which he replaced in his waistcoat pocket and fingered from time to time.
ex.t: 然后她把钥匙交给他后，默默地回到座位上，他把钥匙放回马甲口袋里，不时地用手指抚弄着。

defs.def: to accuse sb of doing sth illegal and tell the police about it 告发；告密
